instruction: A candid full-shot photograph of a couple dynamically dancing tango in a minimalist room with a plain light wall and wooden floor. The man in the gray suit (R1) is on the left, facing right and leaning into the dance step. The woman in the black dress (R2), with a blue flower in her hair bun, is on the right, facing him in a close embrace as she spins, her leg extended back with visible motion blur. Her black dress flares out from the movement. The scene is illuminated by soft, natural light, capturing the fluid motion and energy of their dance against the simple background.
